_README: PLACEHOLDER — finalized in the live build phase. This is the LTX-2.3 single-stage I2V workflow in ComfyUI *API* format (node_id -> {class_type, inputs, _meta}). It is derived from workflows/reference/LTX-2.3_T2V_I2V_Single_Stage_Distilled_Full.json with the cloud GemmaAPITextEncode path swapped for the local LTXVGemmaCLIPModelLoader encoder, and audio save dropped.
